name: MonarchTimezoneSelect
title: TimezoneSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox in its sheet presentation (androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with a search field and a LazyColumn) over java.util.TimeZone.getAvailableIDs, collapsed with android.icu.util.TimeZone.getCanonicalID, with java.util.TimeZone.getOffset and getDisplayName
summary: A searchable IANA time zone picker, labelled by UTC offset and city and sorted by offset, with Detected, Pinned and Recent sections.
whenToUse: Wherever a person chooses a time zone: profile settings, a meeting's zone, a workspace's office hours.
whenNotToUse: Not for showing the time in several zones, which is text or MonarchEventChip times. Not for choosing a city or an address, which is a place search with MonarchCombobox.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTimezoneSelect(label: String, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, zones: List<String>? = null, detectedZone: String? = null, showDetected: Boolean = true, pinned: List<String> = emptyList(), recent: List<String> = emptyList(), now: Long? = null, formatLabel: ((MonarchTimezoneInfo) -> String)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels = MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels())
class MonarchTimezoneInfo(id: String, city: String, region: String, offsetSeconds: Int, offsetLabel: String, longName: String)

class MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels(detected: String? = null, pinned: String? = null, recent: String? = null, all: String? = null, empty: String? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; it names the field and the sheet.

options.name: selected
options.description: The IANA id of the chosen zone, or null. An old id such as Asia/Calcutta selects its current name.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the current id of the chosen zone, or null when the selection is cleared.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; the field is in the error state and TalkBack reads it with the field.

options.name: zones
options.description: Limits the list to these zones. Every location zone the system knows when null.

options.name: detectedZone
options.description: The zone under Detected. The device's zone when null.

options.name: showDetected
options.description: Whether the Detected section is shown.

options.name: pinned
options.description: Zones listed under Pinned, such as the workspace's offices.

options.name: recent
options.description: Zones listed under Recent, such as the person's last choices.

options.name: now
options.description: The instant offsets and long names are computed for, daylight saving included. The time the select first appeared when null.

options.name: formatLabel
options.description: Builds an option's label from the zone's information. Built in: "(UTC+05:30) Kolkata".

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button in the field while a zone is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the section headings, the empty text and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen zone's label, or the placeholder.

states.name: open
states.description: A bottom sheet with a search field and the Detected, Pinned and Recent sections, then every zone by offset under All time zones.

states.name: searching
states.description: Only the full list is searched, so a zone appears once; every word typed must match.

states.name: error, disabled
states.description: As MonarchCombobox: the error under the field, a disabled field that cannot open.

appearance: The MonarchCombobox field and sheet: the field uses the text-field roles, the sheet the raised surface, and each row shows its label with the id and long name under it in the muted text color; the chosen zone has a filled radio mark. All colors come from the theme, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web is an inline combobox with a popup list; on Android MonarchCombobox opens a bottom sheet with a search field and a lazy list, which suits touch and TalkBack. The web lists zones with Intl.supportedValuesOf; Android reads java.util.TimeZone's ids for places (Africa to Pacific, leaving out Etc/ offsets and old country aliases), collapses aliases with ICU's canonical id and reads java.util.TimeZone offsets, because java.time needs API 26 and ICU's location-zone list needs API 28. ICU's canonical ids are often the old names, so ids are mapped to their current names as on the web. Long names follow the configuration's locale instead of a locale prop. The web's and iOS's required mark is not offered because MonarchCombobox has none; say it in helperText. The clear button needs clearIcon, since Monarch bundles no icons. iOS builds the same component with the same name; its selection binding is selected with onSelectedChange, and isClearable and prompt are clearIcon and placeholder.
accessibility: The field is MonarchCombobox's field, read with its label and the chosen zone's label, with a 48dp target.
In the sheet each zone is a row read with its label, id and long name; the chosen one is selected and has a radio mark.
Section headings Detected, Pinned, Recent and All time zones are headings.
The error text is read with the field.
Rows and the field are at least 48dp high, and text scales with the font size.
edgeCases: A selected zone missing from zones is still listed and shown.
A zone the system does not know shows an offset of UTC+00:00 and no long name.
Long names that are only an offset, such as GMT+05:30, are left out.
Building every option reads about 420 zones once per instant and locale; pass zones to limit the list.

examples.title: Detected and pinned zones
examples.template:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    label = {{label}},
    selected = zone,
    onSelectedChange = { zone = it },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    helperText = {{description}},
    detectedZone = {{detectedZone}},
    pinned = listOf({{pinned.0}}, {{pinned.1}}),
    now = {{now|millis}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    label = "Workspace time zone",
    selected = zone,
    onSelectedChange = { zone = it },
    placeholder = "Search city, country or offset",
    helperText = "Reports and reminders use this zone.",
    detectedZone = "Asia/Kolkata",
    pinned = listOf("Europe/London", "America/New_York"),
    now = 1_768_478_400_000L,
)

examples.title: A curated list
examples.code:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    label = "Meeting time zone",
    selected = zone,
    onSelectedChange = { zone = it },
    placeholder = "Choose a time zone",
    errorText = if (zone == null) "Choose a time zone." else null,
    zones = listOf("UTC", "Europe/Paris", "Asia/Kolkata", "America/Los_Angeles"),
    showDetected = false,
)
